svg.title: WakeQuest wiring: ESP32 DevKitC, Tap Module and RGB LED module on a half-size breadboard
svg.text: Top view. USB unplugged while wiring. Everything runs at 3.3 V; the 5V pin stays unused.

g.text: ESP32 board — taken OUT of the breadboard
Labels as printed on your board (USB end at top).
Red ✕ = the 5V pin: never connect anything to it.
use rows 1–14 only (rails may be split further down)
* kit docs: R and B labels may be swapped
Lift the ESP32 out of the breadboard.
Tap Module into c3–c5 (S in c3, − in c5).
RGB module into c10–c13 (R in c10, − in c13).
W1, W2: female on ESP32 pin, male in the rail.
W3, W4, W9: male–male, rail → column a.
W5–W8: female on 27/26/25/33, male in column a.
Check: nothing on 5V, all wires match the table.
Rails run top to bottom: every hole beside the red
line is +3.3 V, every hole beside the blue line is GND.
Never put two module pins in the same row.

svg.text: Female end (black, larger) slides onto an ESP32 header pin · small black square = male end in a breadboard hole.
